allot.subject: Press Release
allot.text: JSW Infrastructure Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 01, 2026, titled "JSW Infrastructure Completes Rs.7,503 Crore QIP; Backed by Marquee Global and Domestic Investors".

allot.subject: Qualified Institutional Placement
allot.text: JSW Infrastructure Limited has informed the Exchange about Qualified Institutional Placement- allotment of equity shares

allot.subject: Allotment of Securities
allot.text: JSW Infrastructure Limited has informed the Exchange regarding allotment of 230000000 securities pursuant to Qualified Institution Placement at its Finance Committee meeting held on Jun 26, 2026

allot.subject: General Updates
allot.text: JSW Infrastructure Limited has informed the Exchange about update on Qualified Institutions Placement- allotment of equity shares

allot.subject: Updates
allot.text: JSW Infrastructure Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Update- Qualified institutions placement of equity shares of face value of Rs. 2 each by JSW Infrastructure Limited and an offer for sale of Equity Shares by Sajjan Jindal Family Trust, as the promoter selling shareholder under the provisions of Chapter VI of Securities and Exchange Board of India (Issue of Capital and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2018, as amended, and Sections 42 and 62 of the Companies Act, 2013 (including the rules made thereunder), as amended'.
